summary: ONE Nuclear Energy Inc. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, confirming the closing of its business combination with Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII (HVII), a Cayman Islands SPAC. Under the October 22, 2025 Business Combination Agreement, as amended through August 7, 2026, HVII merged with ONE Nuclear, LLC, was renamed ONE Nuclear Energy Inc., and will commence trading on Nasdaq under ticker ONEN on September 24, 2026. Concurrently, 13,809,029 Class A ordinary shares were redeemed at approximately $10.61 per share, totaling approximately $146.5 million, leaving a reduced public float and potential overhang. A CEO investor presentation is furnished as Exhibit 99.2. Watch post-closing share redemption levels, trading liquidity, and lock-up expirations.
